content.title: CBS Sports on Instagram: "Bill Self will take some time to make a decision on his future."
content.text: Bill Self will take some time to make a decision on his future.Fabulous Coach. Best of luck to himKentucky and Kansas were both trash this seasonThis man is a first ballot Hall of Famer. He has done an amazing job for 23 years at kansas. He can develop a team and coach almost anybody. The NIL on the other hand has brought players into the league who are not willing to buy into his system. And it is hard for a man of his talents to be able to take these kids and develop them when they know they can just walk out and leave whenever they want because they’re getting paid no matter what. If he leaves, I wish nothing but the best for him and his family. If he stays, I will support him forever. That’s what Jayhawk fans do. We do not just bail on our coach. Look at North Carolina. I understand why they have to move on. But Bill self has won us a national championship twice and has more than a few more years left at them I hope. Rock chalk Jayhawk till the end.He is gonna go replace Mark Pope at KentuckyKU has best class coming in many many years plus guys the already have like Flory (no where near ready for NBA), Tiller, Big Paul, Calderon and Rosario. If they lock up Stokes they have chance to win it all. They will beat better next year regardless.Life is short. There’s more to it than basketball . 🏀 Take care of your healthWe love Coach Self. Kansas has been great during his career. We hope he stays but if he and his family think it’s time to retire we will always be grateful for the best Kansas run and the great games we have had the privilege to watch. No one coaches like him especially in the last minutes of the game!! #legendRetired Bill Self your health is more important and I said this as a Kstate fan Bill Self is a great head coachPlease retire Bill, focus on your health!If he does leave, go write a check for McCollum asapKansas and UNC will be open
